title: Volunteer Hours by Programme
key_sentences: The volunteer office records every session in a shared logbook.
Hours are rounded to the nearest half hour.
Meal delivery remains the programme with the largest commitment.
The repair workshop doubled its sessions after moving to a larger room.
Coordinators are asked to submit the July figures by the tenth of August.
